Tateyomi 0.0.6 (release build, R8 minified)

This APK is signed with the local Android debug keystore so it can be
installed for testing. It is not suitable for store distribution; create a
proper release signing key for that.

Install:
  adb install -r tateyomi-0.0.6-debugsigned.apk

The APK does not contain any EPUB files. Import an EPUB from the library
screen. The androidTest seed assets are not part of this APK.
